AC-042 states, within one row, that its criterion is both out of scope and closable by this package. requirements.md:960 first says 'Discharged by the deferred suite tests/resolve-project-context-caller-contract.tests.sh/.ps1 (design.md Test Strategy item 10), which this package specifies at contract level but does not schedule (tasks.md "Deferred, not scheduled"), so this criterion is not closed by this package's own tasks', and then ends: 'AC-015 and AC-042's own spy-harness half remain closable here'. AC-042's entire criterion content is the spy harness ('a spy-harness fixture on sdd-bootstrap-interviewer's own capability interview phase confirms it never invokes resolve-project-context's own subprocess at all while a Project Context is absent or derives disabled-legacy'), and the same row defines that content as 'distinct from, and in addition to, AC-015's own narrower' check - so AC-042 has no half that AC-015 already covers and no half other than the deferred one. The clause is unique in the document ('closable' occurs exactly once) and is unmirrored: acceptance-tests.md TEST-042 (:93) carries no such qualifier, stating only 'deferred with its suite ... this row is not closed by this package's own tasks'. Downstream failure mode: requirements.md's AC table is the authority a task author and a task/impl reviewer use to decide AC coverage. Under the trailing clause's reading, AC-042 must be closed by a scheduled task, but the frozen tasks.md schedules nine suites and explicitly defers the caller-contract pair - the criterion is then unsatisfiable by the frozen task package, which is the identical defect class as round 2's Critical (AC-026 demanding ten registrations while tasks.md scheduled nine). Under the bolded reading it is satisfiable and excepted. The two readings cannot both govern, and the grammar does not settle it ('half remain' is a plural verb on a singular head, so the subject reads as the two conjuncts 'AC-015' and 'AC-042's own spy-harness half'). This belongs to specification review rather than a later gate because requirements.md is content-frozen once approved and this is a defect in the exclusion boundary the specification itself declares, not in any design, task, or implementation artifact; investigation.md's own round-2 record (:2012-2017, :2029-2031) states the remediation's intent was that AC-042/AC-046/AC-053 'each carry an explicit deferral note', which the trailing clause partially reverses at one site. Major rather than Critical because the row's dominant, bolded statement and its TEST-042 mirror both point unambiguously at full deferral, so the package remains reviewable and the repair is a single-clause deletion or correction; Minor is not sufficient because the clause decides whether a frozen task package is complete, which blocks task decomposition and later verification rather than merely clarifying them.
